description: Returns the field-level schema of one collection: field names, database types, interfaces, required and unique constraints, defaults and relation metadata. Use it before create_item or update_item to learn which fields exist and which are mandatory; use list_collections to find the collection name first, analyze_collection_schema when relationship mapping and constraint checks are also wanted. Read-only. Fails when the collection does not exist or the token cannot read it, and diagnose_collection_access tells those two apart.
name: get_collection_schema
